2607.15388.title: Precise but Uncoupled: Reviewer Precision Does Not Guarantee Critique Uptake in Multi-Agent Math Reasoning
2607.15388.paper_summary: Many math- and science-oriented agent systems use hierarchical designs with specialized reviewer roles, assuming that a dedicated review stage should help turn wrong candidates into correct ones. We test this assumption on 4,181 verifier-grounded Omni-MATH problems using matched gpt-oss-120b actors. Collaboration adds little on the easiest tiers, but from tier 4 onward the gains open sharply; in this harder regime, broadcast-style peer discussion reaches higher final accuracy than a planner-executor-reviewer pipeline (PER). We ask whether this gap is explained by reviewer quality or by whether critique changes the next answer the protocol carries forward. It is not explained by reviewer precision alone: PER's reviewer is more precise than broadcast's (0.861 vs. 0.644), yet evaluator-verified useful critique is much less likely to change the next candidate and produces lower reviewer-guided repair. These results show that reviewer detection quality and critique uptake are empirically separable. Within matched PER interventions, forcing explicit acknowledgment lowers final accuracy, while embedding reviewer guidance directly in the solver's working context partially improves follow-through without closing the gap. Overall, reviewer-centric evaluation can overstate system quality: a protocol may spot errors well yet still fail to solve more problems if it does not act on those critiques.
2607.15388.paper_summary_zh: 許多以數學和科學為導向的代理系統使用層級設計，並具有專門的審查角色，假設專門的審查階段應該能幫助將錯誤的候選者轉變為正確的候選者。<lb/>我們在 4,181 個以驗證者為基礎的 Omni-MATH 問題上測試了這一假設，使用匹配的 gpt-oss-120b 參與者。<lb/>在最簡單的層級上，協作的增益不大，但從第 4 層開始，增益急劇增加；在這個更困難的範疇中，廣播式的同儕討論達到的最終準確度高於計劃者-執行者-審查者管道 (PER)。<lb/>我們詢問這一差距是否由審查者質量解釋，或是由於批評改變了協議所帶來的下一個答案。<lb/>這並不僅僅是由於審查者的精確性：PER 的審查者比廣播的精確（0.861 對 0.644），但經評估確認的有用批評卻不太可能改變下一個候選者，並且產生較低的審查者引導修正。<lb/>這些結果顯示，審查者檢測質量和批評採納在實證上是可分開的。<lb/>在匹配的 PER 介入中，強迫明確承認降低了最終準確度，而將審查者指導直接嵌入解題者的工作背景中部分改善了跟進，但並未縮小差距。<lb/>總體而言，以審查者為中心的評估可能會高估系統質量：一個協議可能能很好地發現錯誤，但如果不對這些批評採取行動，仍然會無法解決更多問題。
